I decided to try the upgrade to Pro . . . And it is a nightmare. I am completely furious and let-down. I recorded an important conversation with my medical consultant and all was working during the call. But afterwards, the recording suddenly vanished. The file is still there, and titled, but it has zero bytes in it. It has a cloud symbol next to it (suggesting that the recording might have been moved to the cloud - even though i didn’t ask for that) but when I click this, absolutely nothing happens. So a vital recording has has been lost by the app. Unbelievable! I will never use this app again, as it can no longer be trusted. Extremely annoying and disappointing.
